description: Every game and the host run on iOS 15.0+ and WebView 80+: one local deep-copy helper replaces structuredClone, index math replaces Array.prototype.at and findLastIndex, and a scan of src/ fails on any ES2022+ built-in that the demo build does not polyfill
deviation_notes: Created 2026-11-22 from the ES2022+ built-in scan of src/ on 2026-11-22: 44 hits outside src/apk3d/audio/ and 2 Object.hasOwn hits inside it. The device gate stays as it is (PM decision 2026-11-22): old Android phones with WebView 80 to 97 are the audience. Due 2026-11-27, before the Storytime launch of 2026-11-30. The scan file widens the audio track scan from src/apk3d/audio/ to src/, hence the single dependency.
